scorecard.rationale: Oral common-sage extract improved several motor tests in a rotenone rat report, and isolated rosmarinic acid altered activity in mice. Neither reported a rigidity measure. The pediatric cream abstract reported no measurable tone effect and unpaired subjective spasticity reports. The effect of ground sage on Parkinson rigidity remains unresolved. Sage features in ethnobotanical inventory and its follow-up. General antispasmodic language supplies no comparison for ground sage and Parkinson muscle rigidity.
